item.title: 'Wellness Ally - Exercise Partner'
item.description:
'

Friendly people that live at Living Well's home in Robbinsdale love to have a partner to exercise with - light weight lifting, stretching, walking.  Scheduling is flexible, one day a week. You can volunteer weekly or bi-weekly.  Volunteer onboarding includes background check and in-person orientation.

'

item.title: 'Better Together - Crafting, Baking, Reading'
item.description:
'

Come have fun doing activities with a woman we support at our home in Brooklyn Center - reading, baking, crafting, and more!  Commitment is flexible - once a week, or every other week, or once a month- you pick the day and location.  No experience needed - just have a caring heart and be ready to share some positive energy!  Sign up as an individual, or a pair.  Volunteers should be 16 or older.  

'

item.title: 'Share the Joy of Books & Reading - Crystal, MN '
item.description:
'

If you like to read out loud, please join a person we support in one of our homes to read stories from their collection of books.  Also listen as he practices reading out loud.  For an hour once a week, or bi-weekly: Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday; late afternoon/early evening.  Living Well Disability Services supports people  in all areas of wellness, including the joy of stories and learning, and hope you can join us! 

'

item.title: 'Better Together - I'm New in Town! West St Paul '
item.description:
'

Get together and visit with a man who lives at Living Well's home in West St Paul who is new to town and interested in exploring the Twin Cities area.  Scheduling a 2 hour time slot weekly or bi-weekly. Volunteer onboarding includes background check, driver record check, and in-person orientation.

'

item.title: 'Fulfilling Senior Holiday Wishes (GROUPS 10-20 VOLUNTEERS)'
item.description:
'

Help make the holiday season special for seniors! You are invited to join volunteers in fulfilling holiday senior wishes at Gifts for Seniors warehouse in Minneapolis - FREE parking.

Volunteers select gifts from our gift inventory based on the senior's request. Complete the gift with a handwritten card and bow. Fun opportunity to volunteer with family, friends, or work group!

If you have a larger group of 10-20 people, please contact us to schedule a shift at COORDINATOR@GIFTSFORSENIORS.ORG 

'
